{{infobox structure | image = Artisan table.png | appearance = Artisan table appearance.png | description = Crafting station | id = piece_artisanstation | type = Crafting | skill = Crafting | durability = 200 | size = 2.8 x 2.6 x 1.9 | materials = * [[Dragon Tear]] x2 * [[Wood]] x10 |resistances=wood | support = wood}} '''Artisan Tables''' are [[Player base|base]] structures used for building [[Blast Furnace]]s, [[Spinning Wheel]]s, [[Windmill]]s, and [[Stone Oven]] within 40 meters. They require [[Dragon Tear]]s, so they can only be built after killing [[Moder]]. Its upgrade is required to build the [[Drakkar]] to reach [[Ashlands]] and is obtained by killing [[The Queen]]. Interacting requires a roof and 70% [[cover]]. Building structures does not require roof or any cover. == Upgrades == Upgrading an Artisan Table enables additional crafting recipes. '''Rugs''' are made from the hides of their respective [[Creatures|creature]] types, while '''carpets''' are made from jute. Both are used as decorative objects.

'''Chairs''' are furniture. They can be used for the player to sit on, or as simple decorative objects. == Common properties == Chairs provide [[comfort]], but they do not stack with each other: only the highest-comfort chair in a player's vicinity will provide comfort.
